Cobalt's balance checks out: 7562 + 22194 - 5470 = 24286. All three balances match the orders minus refunds, and the refunds table matched W2's report, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme at 31368.
Acme's payout of 31368 was recorded successfully. Birch's balance of 19998 has already been checked against its orders minus refunds, so I'll record that payout next.
Acme and birch are paid. Cobalt's balance of 24286 was already checked against its orders minus refunds (7562 + 22194 - 5470), so I'll record that payout to finish the batch.
